name: limited-offer-panel
title: Limited offer panel
description: A founding-member or launch offer with a real count of what is left, what you get and the rule for when the price changes.
docs: Pass title, price (written as you want it, with its currency), priceNote, claimed, total, perks, condition and action. The count is yours and the state follows it: while places are left the button takes the buyer in; when claimed reaches total the meter reads All claimed, the price is struck through and marked as no longer available, and the button turns into Join the waiting list, which goes where waitlist says. Without a waitlist the panel never sends anyone to the action of a closed offer: the button is replaced by a line saying the offer has closed. A closed offer, sold out or ended, never says how many places are left. Write condition in the tense that is true now: The price goes to 249 when all 100 places are gone becomes The price is now 249 once they are. The meter is a progress bar with a name and its value in words, the count of places left gets weight in the last tenth, and every figure is tabular. endsAt is an ISO time with its offset or a plain day that ends with that day in timeZone; it is written in a time element, and once it has passed the panel closes the same way. No timer runs: a page built once corrects itself in the browser, and passing now (the same on the server and in the browser) makes the first paint right when you render per request. locale writes the numbers and the date; labels translates every fixed word.
